_documentation: The ONE place real account names are declared. See README.md beside this file. Both the installed workstation disk and a persistent Controller's durable directory accounts follow this file; the domain_controller role names contract ROLES only (homelab_ad_directory_accounts in ../inventory/group_vars/controllers.yml) and renders the rest from here. Copying this template changes nothing: `principals` is empty, so every account keeps the synthetic name from workstations/identity_lifecycle.json and the acceptance gates are unaffected. The durable-account paths refuse it until standard_user, daily_administrator and domain_administrator are all named here. Fill `principals` in to name your real accounts. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation and are ignored by the loader; every other unknown key is refused.
